sentences.text: 2. The charge sheet is filed against the petitioner for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and Section 4 and 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

3. It is the case of prosecution that, the petitioner by inducing the minor girl, while she had been to the bakery for purchasing some eatables, took her to an under construction building and committed forcible penetrative NC: 2024:KHC:2084 sexual assault on her, on account of which she became pregnant.
4. Perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 (5) of Cr.P.C. and her medical examination report.
At this stage there is a prima facie case against the petitioner.
The date of birth of the victim girl is 03.09.2007, as per the birth certificate and therefore, she is a minor.
5. Considering the nature and gravity of the offence, this is not a fit case to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
